I've answered Tobias in his DM: he should keep Tuesday, Nov 10 at 12:15 free for the Gannet call.

That time comes from his own DM to me on Oct 14. He said his standing call with the Tansleigh Packaging team for the Gannet rollout had moved to Tuesdays at 12:15. The call isn't on his calendar for next week, so I couldn't tell him how long it runs. I offered to add it to his calendar but haven't done that, since he'd said no action was needed back in October.

I only used his own DM and his calendar to answer. I didn't post anything in a channel.
